description: General-purpose display-pipeline debugging fixture: one Display component fed by a 4-branch Geo tree covering every geometry kind ComputeBatch handles, plus matching Name/Layer/Metadata trees and a Three Material. Not a single-bug regression fixture — use it as a starting canvas for any display/WebDisplay/BatchBlobCache debugging session.

branches.name: GridMesh
branches.geometry: Regular box mesh (Mesh.CreateFromBox, 20x20x20 divisions, 2646 verts / 2400 faces). Deliberately regular/repetitive so DEFLATE crushes it under BatchBlobCache.MinCacheableBytes (16 KB) -- exercises the 'never stored' path.

branches.name: RandomMesh
branches.geometry: 4000 random vertices (Random(1337)), 1333 faces. High-entropy, does not compress away -- exercises BatchBlobCache's real hit/miss path. Re-solving without changing this branch's inputs is the way to verify a cache hit.

branches.name: SampleCurve
branches.geometry: 4-point closed-ish NURBS polyline. Non-meshable -- exercises the DisplayItem.Curve path in GH_WebDisplay.TryBuildItem, not the mesh-merge path.

branches.name: SamplePoint
branches.geometry: Single Point3d(50,50,50). Exercises the DisplayItem.Point path.

material.note: Single Three Material item broadcast across all 4 branches via Grasshopper's shortest-list matching. Color set to RGB(70,130,220) (a distinct blue) so it's visually obvious in a viewer; Metalness 0, Roughness 0.5, Opacity 1, Transparent false (component defaults).

persistent_data_note: The recipe format above only covers placement/wiring -- the four branches of geometry/name/layer/metadata are set as PersistentData on the geo/name/layer/meta params directly (SetPersistentData with explicit GH_Path(0..3)), not wired from upstream components. There is no generic recipe step for this; rebuild via run_csharp following the branch table above, then SetPersistentData per param before wiring into Display. See the rhino-mcp skill for the SetPersistentData pattern.

expect.note: Display's Web Display output should show 4 branches: {0} and {1} report '1 materials, 1 groups' (meshes), {2} and {3} report '0 materials, 0 groups' (curve/point go through DisplayItem, not mesh groups). Verify with g1_get_canvas_graph.
